title: Grey Talon: tier bits, 1-charge Extra Charge, Extra Charge value at Charged Shot T2 vs T3
question: (F9) Do abil bits 1/3/7/15 give unlocked/T1/T2/T3, i.e. was `unlock 7` only T2? (F7) Does Extra Charge add a charge to an ability whose base AbilityCharges is 1 (Kieran's reading: no, needs 2+)? (M) Does Extra Charge add burst before Charged Shot T3?
hypothesis: F9: bits 3 gives 2 charges 4s apart; bits 15 gives between-charge 1s. F7 (60% prior, 1-charge counts): bits 1 + EC gives 2 shots, 2nd >= 4s after the 1st. M: at bits 7 + EC the 3rd shot does not land inside a 6s window; at bits 15 + EC 3 shots land inside it.

arms.name: D_bits7_EC
arms.notes: timeline state of greytalon at 800-5999 souls

setup.level_or_boons: sandbox default (50k souls, level from setup); tiers forced with abil
setup.position: mid lane, enemy Haze bot 350u (fetch default)
resets: abil set after hardreset (hardreset re-issues unlock 7)

controls: abilist logged before each block: bits must read 1/3/7/15 or the block is void
only Extra Charge differs inside each pair
procedure: count ability_charged_shot damage rows per mark and the time from first to last hit
repeat 5 runs (one run = all six blocks, so arms interleave)

metrics.name: arrow_hits_in_block
metrics.how: damage csv rows with ability ability_charged_shot, victim enemy, per mark

metrics.name: damage_per_arrow
metrics.how: mean damage per arrow row (T2 adds 54, T3 adds 1.0x spirit)

decision.rule: F9 SUPPORTED if C has 2 hits >=3.5s apart and E/F show <=1.5s between hits; else F9 REFUTED (bits mean something else) and every sandbox result run at unlock 7 must be re-labelled. F7 SUPPORTED (1-charge counts) if B has 2 hits in >=4/5 trials while A has 1; REFUTED if B == A. M SUPPORTED if E has more hits than D in the same window in >=4/5 trials.

predictions_from_timeline.D_vs_E: shots in 5s 2 -> 2 at T2, 2 -> 3 at T3 (EC gain starts at Charged Shot T3 @6000, +5200 souls after the EC buy)

verdict_use: F7 result decides 14 CHARGE-BEFORE-CHARGES rows (gate/*.json). Until run: inconclusive, keep current builds (FREEZE).
